metadata.title: What Is Seedance? ByteDance's AI Video Model Explained
metadata.description: Seedance is ByteDance's AI video model. It turns text, images and reference clips into video with sound. See versions, what 2.5 can do and where to use it.

hero.label: Explainer
hero.title: What is Seedance?
hero.description: Seedance is a family of AI video generation models made by ByteDance. You give it a text prompt, an image or reference clips, and it returns a short video with matching sound. The current version, Seedance 2.5, was released on July 31, 2026 and makes clips up to 30 seconds long.
hero.verdict: Seedance is a model, not a single website. You reach it through ByteDance's own apps such as Dreamina, through API providers, or through independent workspaces like this one.
hero.source_note: Release dates and model limits come from the linked sources. SeedanceAI.dev is an independent service and is not affiliated with or endorsed by ByteDance, Doubao or Dreamina.

sections.title: What can Seedance do?
paragraphs: Seedance creates video in three ways. Text-to-video builds a clip from a written prompt. Image-to-video animates a still image used as the first frame, with an optional last frame. Reference-to-video combines several images, clips or audio files to keep a character, product or style consistent.

Since version 1.5 the model generates audio together with the picture, including dialogue with lip-sync, sound effects and ambience. The [Seedance 2.5 prompt guide](/seedance-2-5-prompt-guide) shows how to direct those elements.

sections.title: Seedance versions and release dates
paragraphs: ByteDance has shipped four public versions in a little over a year. Seedance 2.0 also comes in cheaper Fast and Mini tiers. For a field-by-field comparison of the two current versions, see [Seedance 2.5 vs 2.0](/seedance-2-5-vs-2-0).

rows: 1080p video from text and image prompts, including multi-shot clips
Audio and video generated together, with multilingual lip-sync
Clips up to 15 seconds and up to 15 reference files
Clips up to 30 seconds and up to 50 reference files

sections.title: Where can you use Seedance?
paragraphs: There are three routes. ByteDance's consumer apps, Dreamina and CapCut, are the official way to use it. Developers call it through API providers; the [Seedance 2.5 API guide](/seedance-2-5-api) covers prices and code. Independent workspaces such as this site wrap those APIs in a browser generator and charge credits.
bullets: API providers: Kie, fal and others
Independent workspaces: SeedanceAI.dev and similar sites

sections.title: Is Seedance free?
paragraphs: Seedance is a paid model, but most platforms give new accounts a small free allowance. Paid use is billed per second of video, and the price rises with resolution. See [Seedance 2.5 free](/seedance-2-5-free) for how starter credits work here and [Seedance 2.5 pricing](/pricing) for the full credit table.

faqs.question: What is Seedance?
faqs.answer: Seedance is ByteDance's family of AI video generation models. It turns text prompts, images and reference clips into short videos with synchronized sound.

faqs.question: Who made Seedance?
faqs.answer: ByteDance, the company behind TikTok, CapCut and Dreamina. The first version was released on June 11, 2025.

faqs.question: What is the latest version of Seedance?
faqs.answer: Seedance 2.5, released on July 31, 2026. It generates clips up to 30 seconds and accepts up to 50 reference files. A formal Seedance 3.0 release was not verified in the sources reviewed.

faqs.question: Is Seedance the same as Dreamina?
faqs.answer: No. Seedance is the model. Dreamina is one of ByteDance's apps that runs it.

faqs.question: Is SeedanceAI.dev the official Seedance site?
faqs.answer: No. SeedanceAI.dev is an independent service that uses third-party API access. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by ByteDance.
